instruction: Can you help me switch Chrome's appearance back to the default system theme? I accidentally changed it and now the color scheme doesn't match my desktop environment, which is causing visual inconsistency.

metadata.explanation: Task variation focuses on resetting Chrome to system theme. Marked as infeasible because Chrome theme synchronization with system settings cannot be reliably automated and verified in the OSWorld environment.
